messages.content:
Risk: Insufficient upstream transparency
Description: The AI system's upstream providers or components in the value chain may lack transparency, potentially increasing uncertainty and risk, and making it challenging to assess the system's compliance, performance, or security.
Concern: None
Policy: Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risks

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments.
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage.
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics.
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ProcessDisclosure: Process Disclosure — Disclosing confidential manufacturing processes, business methods, or operational procedures that constitute trade secrets.
  Siblings: Customer List Disclosure, Formula Disclosure
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000627: Infrastructure Element — A Material Entity that bears an Infrastructure Role.
  Siblings: portion of pathological body substance, Target, physical sign
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001141: Infrastructure Role — A Role that inheres in the bearer of a Disposition and has been assigned to an Infrastructure System such that the realization of that Disposition is sometimes part of the functioning of the Infrastructure System. [from restriction: BFO_0000196 on ont00000627]
  Siblings: Allegiance Role, Part Role, medication role

axes.rationale: The risk of insufficient upstream transparency is related to the potential unauthorized revelation of confidential business information, which aligns with the concept of trade secret disclosure.

The risk involves the lack of transparency in upstream processes, which could lead to the disclosure of confidential manufacturing processes or business methods, aligning with the concept of process disclosure.
The risk pertains to the components or elements within the supply chain, which can be considered as infrastructure elements that lack transparency.
